content_sections.heading: About the College
content_sections.text: Nalanda College of Agriculture is located at M. R. Palayam, Sanamanagalam (Po), Mannachanallur (Tk), Tiruchirappalli – 621104, Tamil Nadu. The college is affiliated to Tamil Nadu Agricultural University, Coimbatore, and its letterhead carries the line "Bonded for Growth". The notice, dated 16 November 2026, is issued by the Principal, Dr. J. Venkata Pirabu.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice lists 3 Assistant Professor posts across three disciplines. It does not give a category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The same qualification applies to all three disciplines. NET qualification is optional, because the notice accepts candidates "with / without NET qualification". The notice asks applicants to send copies of their experience certificates, but it does not prescribe a minimum period of experience. The notice also does not mention an age limit. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.qualification: Candidate should possess a M.Sc. / Ph.D. Degree from SAUs/ CAUs/ ICAR / Government or other recognized institutions with / without NET qualification

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The salary for the Assistant Professor posts is "As per the norms of TNAU and based on their expertise". The notice prints no pay level or amount, and it does not mention allowances. The nature of the appointment (regular, contract or temporary), the tenure and any probation are not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NCA Assistant Professor
content_sections.text: Applications are sent by email only. The notice gives these instructions: Prepare your resume. Attach copies of your supporting academic certificates. Attach copies of your supporting experience certificates. Email the application to [email protected] or [email protected] . Send it on or before 21 November 2026 . After the last date, shortlisted candidates will be called for interview. The notice does not give the interview date, time or venue, and it does not specify an email subject line or an application form.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Resume Copies of supporting academic certificates Copies of supporting experience certificates

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NCA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 Assistant Professor posts, one each in Plant Pathology, Horticulture and Agronomy.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the NCA Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Applications must be emailed on or before 21 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the NCA Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess a M.Sc. / Ph.D. Degree from SAUs/ CAUs/ ICAR / Government or other recognized institutions, with or without NET qualification.

faq.question: Q4. Is NET compulsory for the Assistant Professor posts at Nalanda College of Agriculture?
faq.answer: No. The notice accepts candidates with or without NET qualification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of an NCA Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: The salary is as per the norms of TNAU and based on the candidate's expertise. The notice does not print a pay amount.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the NCA Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Email your resume with copies of supporting academic and experience certificates to [email protected] or [email protected] on or before 21 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the NCA Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Applications will be shortlisted, and shortlisted candidates will be called for interview.

faq.question: Q8. In which disciplines are the Assistant Professor posts at Nalanda College of Agriculture?
faq.answer: The posts are in Plant Pathology, Horticulture and Agronomy, with one post in each discipline.
